messages:
Oliver - Events: Heads-up: planning a joint webinar with StratusGrid + NimbleEdge — aim to simulcast to APAC & EMEA regional hubs. Need speaker alignment, demo fallback, and swag/customs plan. Who can own speaker coordination + runbook?

Maria (Partnerships): I can own speaker lineup. Suggest 3 speakers from our side: Oliver (product), Ruth (solutions eng), and a StratusGrid TPM. Need one backup from our side in case of last-minute drop.

Ajay K: I'll coordinate with StratusGrid to lock speaker slots. Proposed windows: 9am PT / 6pm CET simulcast. Thoughts?

Sana R: For APAC we should shift +8 hours. Recommend ~7pm SGT local to avoid midnight for JP/KR attendees.

Kevin L: Demo plan: primary live on Redwood Dedicated (GPU pool) + NimbleEdge hardware as live fallback. Need minimal dataset + canned prompt set. Ruth — can you produce a smoke test script?

Ruth (Solutions Eng): Working on smoke test. I'll post the script to #eng-releases. Quick snippet for CI:

./run_demo.sh --model=repro-1 --seq=512 --seed=42

This validates latency and output sanity.

OpsBot: Reminder: submit swag shipment to logistics by 1745006000 to meet customs clearance windows.

Maria (Partnerships): Swag kit idea: sticker + T-shirt + NFC info card. For EMEA customs we need HS code and invoice. Does marketing have an invoice template we can reuse?

Oliver - Events: Marketing will supply invoice template. @Sana please confirm preferred courier for APAC shipments.

Sana R: We'll use FlashShip for APAC. Typical customs hold 2-3 days, recommend sending kits earlier. I'll share FlashShip SLA and a local contact.

Ajay K: Speaker rehearsals: propose two dry-runs — tech check (30m) and full run-through (45m). Dates: June 6 (tech) & June 12 (run-through). Any conflicts?

Kevin L: :thumbsup: June 12 works for me. Also adding a network checklist for NimbleEdge remote demo connection to the runbook.

Ruth (Solutions Eng): Fallback if NimbleEdge fails: switch to 5-min pre-recorded demo + live Q&A. I'll prepare a recording and a 'failure script' slide with steps we'll read.

Maria (Partnerships): Need volunteers to monitor Q&A in each region. Recommend 2 people per region (APAC/EMEA/AMER).

Oliver - Events: I'll cover EMEA chat. @Ajay you take Americas? @Sana cover APAC?

Ajay K: Yes, I'll handle Americas. Also coordinating recording & timing for the cloud marketplace announcement — plan to announce listing 24h after the webinar to avoid clipping with live QA.

Sana R: APAC covered. Also need localized registration copy for JP & KR. Marketing team, can you help?

MarketingBot: Action assigned: localization for JP & KR to marketing-local. ETA 5 business days.

Kevin L: Ops checklist item for pre-event: pre-pull quantized model to NimbleEdge nodes and warm KV cache. Command to run:

rdwctl preload --node nimble-01 --model repro-1-q4

Ruth (Solutions Eng): Scheduling smoke run 48h before event. We'll capture token-level logs and a minimal perf dashboard (latency + p95 + errors).

Maria (Partnerships): Owners recap:
- Speaker lineup: Maria
- Speaker rehearsals: Ajay + Ruth
- Demo & fallback: Kevin + Ruth
- Swag & shipping: Sana + Marketing
- Recording & marketplace: Ajay
- Runbook owner: Oliver
I'll update the invite and add calendar slots for the rehearsals.

Oliver - Events: Thanks all — I'll draft the runbook doc (checklist + network + fallback scripts) and ping when ready. Flag blockers here ASAP.

Ajay K: Noted. I'll DM StratusGrid to lock speakers and share bios.

Sana R: I'll open the shipping ticket and attach FlashShip SLA.

Kevin L: Preparing preload scripts and a short ops checklist for the runbook.

Ruth (Solutions Eng): I'll upload the demo recording and smoke test outputs to the runbook drive.

Oliver - Events: Great. Leave any questions here. :party_parrot:
